items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Clifford Brown, Blue Mitchell, Kenny Dorham... The first one is with Horace Silver and Art Blakey and Blue Mitchell, and Gene Ramey.

ctx.x: Yup. Yup. But, see, music... Let me tell you something about music before you cut this off. You talk about Wynton. Now, Wynton did something that is very hard to do. He brought this music back and got back the dignity, the stuff that people used to have in the music before the junkie era. Because I remember when I was a kid, musicians used to come through Greensboro and get stranded, and people would let them come to their house and stay, and they’d feed them and everything, until they got another job. But not…
It’s complicated, because he’s trying to function as a composer also...
